name: yelp-mcp
description: Yelp Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_yelp_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YELP_USERNAME
platform_mcp_yelp_username.description: Yelp Partner API username (the same Basic-auth credentials as the Data Ingestion API; issued by your Yelp account team, access is disabled by default: https://docs.developer.yelp.com/docs/ads-api).

platform_mcp_yelp_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YELP_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_yelp_password.description: Yelp Partner API password (Basic HTTP authentication on partner-api.yelp.com).

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /programs/v1?limit=1 (Program List All), which checks the Basic-auth partner credentials against the payment account.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /programs/v1?offset&limit (max 40)&program_status: every advertising program (CPC, EP, BP, …) under the credentials' payment account; `account_id` is not sent (the credentials select the account). `status` is one of current/active, paused, past/ended, future/scheduled, all (Yelp's default is CURRENT). `name` is the program type; `budget` is the MONTHLY budget in cents (program_metrics.budget); raw.program_pause_status says NOT_PAUSED/PAUSED and raw.businesses lists the Yelp business ids.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /program/{program_id}/pause/v1 or /resume/v1 (HTTP 202, empty body) for a running CPC program. Yelp marks this 'This feature is coming soon — Please get in touch if you would like to get early access', so partners without early access get an error.
